title: Hearty Malaysian Shrimp Satay
description: A quick-fix Malaysian dish featuring jumbo shrimp, caramelized to perfection, with an earthy and velvety flavor profile, garlic and onion free.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, coriander powder, cumin powder, palm sugar, fish sauce, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, if using.
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp satay hot with your choice of sides, such as steamed rice or roasted vegetables.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Repeat with remaining shrimp and marinade.
